description: Which rows of results/sessions/*.jsonl are scored, and the few category fixes made after a trial. results.jsonl files are the evaluation runner's own logs, copied byte for byte; every decision below was made and written down on the day, in the rig's dated validation records named in 'source'. analysis/reproduce_counts.py applies this file and nothing else.

not_scored_tags.act_smoke: executor smoke tests before the formal run (random positions, executor fixes in between)
not_scored_tags.smolvla_smoke: executor smoke test before the formal run
not_scored_tags.dp_smoke: Diffusion Policy smoke tests before the formal run (original model, then n_action_steps 16 and 31)
not_scored_tags.act_c2far: extra position 5 cm beyond C2, added after the 20 trials, one run per policy; reported separately
not_scored_tags.smolvla_c2far: extra position 5 cm beyond C2, reported separately
not_scored_tags.dp_c2far: extra position 5 cm beyond C2, reported separately

invalid_runs.reason: executor fault (CPU contention made joint feedback too old) latched before the task finished; rerun
gripper still open from the previous timeout; the start check refused before enabling, no motion; rerun
operator forgot to place the cube; rerun
cube placed at the wrong position (inside the frame near A1 instead of the protocol's out-of-distribution spot, checked on the start frame); rerun at the protocol position
gripper started open; the start check refused before enabling, no motion; rerun
executor fault at 47 s (J1 feedback too old), treated like the Task 1 executor faults; rerun

category_fixes.reason: operator chose drop but described 'reached the cube but did not close and grasp'; by definition a grasp miss. Success is unchanged.

notes: t2_gen_pi05_20261019 trial 38 was entered as success by mistake and corrected to grasp_miss on the day; the logged row already carries the correction (field 'correction').
In t1_eval_20261016 the *_c2far rows reuse trial index 7 and carry split in_distribution; they are an extra out-of-distribution position, not Task 1 trial 7.
